document.abstract: (1.1) This standard specifies the lateral positions and width dimensions of two 3.81 mm (0.150 in) magnetic audio records and a control track on 16-mm single-perforated magnetic recording film. (1.2) This standard also specifies the reproducing velocity of the film travel.
